data.narrative:
Profluent is a seed-stage biotech company founded by Ali Madani that has raised $150M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparison universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private-stage companies across the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three triangulation methods assessed, only stage-progression analysis proved applicable. Using $5M as a proxy base value derived from total capital raised, and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical for seed-to-next-stage progression in biotech, this method implied a $12M valuation. Peer-median analysis was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparable data within narrow valuation tiers (0 matches across applicable filters). Public comparables anchoring could not be completed because the target's revenue is not disclosed; while the three public biotech peers trade at a median P/S multiple of 8.1x, this multiple cannot be applied without revenue data.

The triangulated valuation range supported by available analysis is $11M to $14M, with a median of $12M. This range reflects single-method support and carries material uncertainty. Key limitations include reliance on a stage-progression methodology alone, lack of direct peer revenue or profitability benchmarks, and the absence of disclosed financials for the target. Resolution of revenue estimates and identification of tighter seed-stage comparables would materially strengthen conviction in this range.
